build_tokens_input: build a token-based engine input from a list of prompt token IDs with optional prompt text and cache salt
build_embeds_input: build an embeddings-based engine input from a torch tensor of prompt embeddings with optional prompt text
build_mm_input: build a multi-modal engine input with prompt token IDs, multi-modal kwargs, hashes, and placeholder ranges
build_enc_dec_input: build an encoder-decoder engine input from separate encoder and decoder singleton inputs with a decoder start token id
split_enc_dec_input: split an encoder-decoder engine input into separate encoder and decoder singleton inputs
